title: I don’t trust my agents either
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: You are not being careful. You are squinting at widgets.
quotes.why_it_matters: Directly challenges the false confidence of manual review, showing that reviewing code by eye is inspection (a failing approach) not process design (a working one).

quotes.text: Thin layer on thin layer on thin layer, and what you finally get to stand on is thick.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why many small, focused checks stacked in sequence create reliable confidence, whereas a single overloaded reviewer creates false confidence.
